name: Activity Flowchart
description: Chain of activities and decisions with rework loops
whenToUse: When a process is a chain of activities and yes/no decisions with rework loops — not for a plain chain without branches (Process Map covers that).
addStepToBand: Add an activity to this detour
addDecisionToBand: Add a decision to this detour
insertHere: Insert here — or drop a card here to move it
emptyHint: No steps yet — use the toolbar to add an activity or decision.
importHint: Pick a source. Its steps are appended to the end of the chain.
importEmptyHint: No matching source (SIPOC / Process Map) found in this project.
pickEntryTitle: Click the re-entry point — without one the stream ends here
clearRejoin: Drop the re-entry — the stream then ends here
importFailed: Import failed: the source is no longer available.
bandNotBefore: The step cannot go into this band: its decision only stands behind it.
notDecision: Only a decision has a re-entry.
targetNotInBand: A re-entry can only be another step of the band the decision stands in.

invariants.uniqueStepIds: Every step needs an identifier of its own.
invariants.uniqueSubstepIds: Every sub-step needs an identifier of its own within its step.
invariants.decisionShape: Exactly a decision carries a question and a re-entry; an activity has none.
invariants.knownBranch: A step stands in the main path or in the band of a decision that comes before it in the chain.
invariants.knownNoTarget: The re-entry of a decision is the process end or another existing step.
invariants.validExpanded: Only existing steps can be expanded.
